findings.title: Issued handoff rereads caller-owned authority after the verified V3 snapshot
evidence: issueRecommendationOutcomeEvidenceV3 later constructs the V2 authority from dependencies.authority.expected_issuer_anchor instead of the verified snapshot
a read_issuance_material callback that mutates the original trust_root_digest after snapshotting is locally classified issued, reaches S.2A, and throws v3_pre_admission_diverged_from_s2a_sanitized
findings.impact: The V3 pre-admission decision and the S.2A invocation do not share one immutable authority handoff. A caller-owned post-snapshot mutation can create locally-issued/S.2A-rejected divergence, so full admission parity, authority binding and issued interoperability are not proven.
findings.required_future_remediation: Carry a deep-frozen verified request and authority snapshot across the issued handoff and pass only those bytes to V2; never reread requestValue or dependencies.authority after pre-admission. Add the exact mutation probe to the normative differential matrix.

review_dimensions.evidence: The self-consistent completion extra-field payload is rejected locally before S.2A request construction, calls or digest work.
The frozen matrix has no false-issued result for its listed payloads, but the independent post-snapshot authority-mutation probe produces a locally-issued/S.2A-rejected divergence.
All frozen incomplete, conflicting, not_point_in_time_safe and unmappable scenarios show zero S.2A request construction, zero calls and zero downstream digest work.
Parity fails under caller-owned authority mutation after the local snapshot because the issued path rereads the mutable original anchor.
Distinct rejected observed sections retain distinct failure identities with sorted reason codes.
The frozen classifier checks nanosecond temporal finality and immutable opportunity membership before issued classification.
The locally verified authority snapshot is not the authority object used for the V2 issued handoff.
The static synthetic issued fixture completes the S.2A-to-O.2A chain, but issued interoperability is not invariant under the independently reproduced authority TOCTOU attack.
Disabled and kill-switch paths return before request inspection, authority reads, cloning, classification or downstream work.
The predecessor tree remains 6ae8fb710eceb8c37824e04360f5a7602d0d4e64 and PR #71 remains open/draft/unmerged at e1269cbd77eb29bc4bf5c4e79f97be6326a7f0ae.
The frozen 16-case suite passes in UTC, Europe/Stockholm and America/New_York, and its canonical golden result is stable under reversed case order.
Normalized 303-artifact and replay 84-artifact roots retain their digests, 0700/0600 permissions and zero symlinks; no real outcome source was accessed.

closed_threat_matrix.threat: Exact T7-001 self-consistent extra completion field
Field stripping, extra fields, closure substitution or ordering drift
Temporal, finality, trust-root or membership drift in frozen material
Getter, proxy, cycle or depth-budget attack
Post-snapshot mutation of caller-owned authority anchor during material callback

regression.t7a_focused_across_timezones: 16/16 passed in each of UTC, Europe/Stockholm and America/New_York
regression.external_roots: 303 normalized / 84 replay; digest and permission safe
